technology_name: Decision Support System for Soil Erosion: Web-Based Digital Tool
institution: KSCSTE- Centre for Water Resources Development and Management (CWRDM)
technology_type: Software/Digital Platform, Database/GIS System, Decision-Support/Analytical Tool
problem_solved: Widespread challenge of soil erosion in hilly, high-rainfall regions requiring localized, science-backed mitigation planning.
description: The Decision Support System (DSS) for Soil Erosion is a freely accessible, web-based digital tool tailored for hilly, high-rainfall regions. It transforms complex geospatial data—integrating specific data on rainfall, land use, and topography—into accessible maps. Users can zoom into specific Panchayats to view erosion risk levels and receive customized mitigation suggestions, such as vegetative cover, contour bunds, or drainage structures. The tool requires no login or specialized software, supporting grassroots planning, watershed development, and programs like MGNREGS.
applications:
• Grassroots-level planning for soil and water conservation by government bodies and Panchayats

• Integration into official watershed development and MGNREGS programs

• Environmental governance and land-use planning by NGOs and researchers

• Deployment as a scalable geospatial model for other high-rainfall or hilly topographies
